page.layout: One page of text: a heading "DEDICATIO." at the top, then the dedication paragraph, the addressee lines and the signature centred below; at the foot right "EPI-" (catchword). No margin notes. Digitiser's watermark "Digitized by Google" at lower right is excluded.

main_text.head: DEDICATIO.
main_text.p: flagrantissimus ille literarum amor, quo non aliud validius decet florente Republica usuros, & prosperam sui memoriam parantes. Cujus ego fiducia magnopere fretus, Vestra gratia atque auctoritate istas meas ingenii curas tuebor, si eis aliquod patrocinium polliciti videbimini. Deus Vos, ILLUSTRISSIMI DOMINI, quam maxime longævos & felicissimos esse velit jubeat! Dab. Steinfurti, IV. Non. Martiis Anno Christiano M DC LXI.

page.notes: The first word "flagrantissimus" has an ornamental initial "f" in the print, read as "flagrantissimus". The catchword "EPI-" is a printed catchword at the lower right. The dedication's opening line lacks an indent; paragraph structure follows the printed layout.
